ayahs.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا مِنْ آيَاتِنَا عَجَبًا
ayahs.translation_en: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.translation_en: When the youth retreated to the cave and said, 'Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.'

ayahs.arabic: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَاهُمْ هُدًى
ayahs.translation_en: It is We who relate to you their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا فَقَالُوا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
ayahs.translation_en: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, 'Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth.'

ayahs.arabic: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰ آذَانِهِمْ فِي الْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًا
ayahs.translation_en: So We cast over their ears in the cave for a number of years.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَأْوُوا إِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ
ayahs.translation_en: And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, then retreat to the cave; your Lord will spread for you of His mercy.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَاوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ
ayahs.translation_en: And you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ
ayahs.translation_en: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِيَتَسَاءَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ
ayahs.translation_en: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, 'How long have you remained?' They said, 'We have remained a day or part of a day.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَابْعَثُوا أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ
ayahs.translation_en: They said, 'Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city.'

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
ayahs.translation_en: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt.

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَاثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًا بِالْغَيْبِ
ayahs.translation_en: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth being their dog, guessing at the unseen.
